How to pay you without a card. Each instruction is a block of plain-text label and value pairs — bank name, account number, reference — that is rendered onto the customer-facing invoice PDF and HTML.

Plain text on both halves deliberately: this lands on a document you send to customers, so no markup is accepted. Archiving is soft, and invoices already issued keep the instructions they were rendered with.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-instructions/list-payment-instructions) | List payment instructions |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-instructions/create-a-payment-instruction) | Create a payment instruction |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-instructions/retrieve-a-payment-instruction) | Retrieve a payment instruction |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-instructions/edit-a-payment-instruction) | Edit a payment instruction |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-instructions/archive-a-payment-instruction) | Archive a payment instruction |
